description: This file defines utility functions related to session key management within an application, including normalization, creation, and validation of session keys.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw session key by trimming whitespace and defaulting to 'main' if empty.

methods.name: makeAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs an agent-specific session key by combining agent ID and base key after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks whether a session key is the canonical main session key, recognizing specific labels.
